title: Downstream review of asynchronously registered code-state joins
problem: The async coord_join repair changes the handoff between daemon coordination and code-state registration, so an independent downstream reviewer must receive the exact impact and validate the consumer-facing behavior.

acceptanceCriteria.condition: A reviewer with an active overlapping verification intent receives an explainable ImpactDetected route without an explicit WorkItem dependency.
The independent reviewer runs the daemon join-latency and code-state suites and records their exact pass/fail result.
The reviewer can replay bounded sync and receives the same routed event keys without duplicate downstream work.
The reviewed implementation remains covered by green Windows Node 24, Ubuntu Node 22/24, macOS Node 24, and CodeQL checks.

evidencePlan.coordination: Persist implementation/reviewer WorkItems, sessions, overlapping intents, ImpactDetected reasons, sync replay, and reviewer completion.
evidencePlan.evaluation: Use a server-registered review spec bound to a stable receipt; do not treat reviewer declarations as evaluator authority.
evidencePlan.correctness: Bind reviewer test output and the implementation commit's remote check runs to the final review record.
